rig.note: pyro 1.9.1 has no PyroLBFGS; the polish is torch.optim.LBFGS on the AutoDelta guide's unconstrained parameters against the same Trace_ELBO loss

optimiser.scheme: (i) rig, latents at zero; then per round (ii) each window's latents, rig fixed, [ridge step,] (iii) rig, latents fixed; stop when the Whittle term and the total objective move < tol per cell; a rig L-BFGS on a frame subset ends in one all-frames rig L-BFGS polish
optimiser.loss_note: lbfgs_loss_after is the TOTAL objective Whittle + rig -log prior + OU -log prior on the full pool at the final rig and latents (what restarts reduce on)

first_rig.note: pyro 1.9.1 has no PyroLBFGS; the polish is torch.optim.LBFGS on the AutoDelta guide's unconstrained parameters against the same Trace_ELBO loss

last_rig.note: pyro 1.9.1 has no PyroLBFGS; the polish is torch.optim.LBFGS on the AutoDelta guide's unconstrained parameters against the same Trace_ELBO loss

polish.loss_note: Whittle - rig log prior on the FULL pool at the final latents

gamma_hz.source: bench decoherence law V_eps ~ 0.09 k^1.1 tau^0.43 rad^2

profile_db.loc: measured floor at k f_r - 12 dB - 15 dB [k % 2 != 0]
profile_db.rule: every order; centre below the floor; blade-pass parity

priors.mic: none: channels normalised in the data

provenance.front_end: 2048/512 periodic Hann, 16 kHz, frame-mean label carriers
provenance.units: sigma_*: stationary sd in dB; tau_*: OU correlation time in s; block_s in s
provenance.line_estimator: mic-mean order-tracked line level (3 bins at the label carrier minus the local q25 floor), speed law (f/f_ref)^2 removed, centred per line on its regime mean; d = lag-0 cross moment of two lines of one rotor with tau over lags 1-4 (the line set above)
provenance.v_estimator: sigma_v_db / tau_v_s: the POOLED all-track value -- every classified track (valid in >= 80 % of its window's blocks); block prominence = 10 log10(10^((mu + d + v + e + o) / 10) + eta): v the per-line OU fitted, d the rotor-common OU held at (sigma_d, tau_d), e white block noise s2, o the speed law minus the track's measured local floor deviation, eta line-free cell ratios; mu matched to each track's median; per-track centring, model draws centred alike (sigma = stationary sd); weight = line fraction at the track median, squared; sigma from the weighted lag-0 sum, tau from lags 1-4; sigma_v_db_by_order[i] holds for orders k_edges[i] <= k < k_edges[i+1]; tau_v_s_by_order (present only when some group's tau is pinned by the window bootstrap, 95/5 % ratio < 4) carries the pooled tau_v where tau_source says so
provenance.floor_estimator: mic-mean comb-masked level on bands around the 14 floor control points, speed law mean_i (f_i/f_ref)^2 removed, centred per band on its regime mean; u = lag-0 cross-band moment with tau over lags 1-4, uj = auto minus u
provenance.block_noise: measured: within-block frame scatter (lines); exact correlated-cell Gamma count x mic coherence (floor)

resolvable_lines.note: schema 1: the per-line residual on the resolvable lines only

wander.note: Round 4a: NO block wander. Every sigma of michaels.json set to 0 (taus, block_s, uj_corr_oct kept) so the fit is rig-only (fit_latents is a no-op) and a render draws no latent tracks. Source record: results/noise_v3/wander/michaels.json

channel_gains.rule: rank-one floor gain per channel, mean over the band groups ['30-300', '300-1k', '1k-3k', '3k-8k'] (rigs.<rig>.wind.excess_db_by_band_group), re-centred on the channels used; each channel's periodogram is divided by 10^(g/10)

latents.shapes: d (R, B), v (R, K, B), u (B,), uj (J, B) per window
latents.note: per-window MAP nuisance; NOT rendered (render_noise draws fresh OU tracks)

channel_gains.rule: rank-one floor gain per channel, mean over the band groups ['30-300', '300-1k', '1k-3k', '3k-8k'] (rigs.<rig>.wind.excess_db_by_band_group), re-centred on the channels used; each channel's periodogram is divided by 10^(g/10)

gamma_low_order_check.rule: pass = every gamma_rk at k <= 4 within floor_factor of 1 / (2 T); above the floor, fail_k2_ramp = gamma_4 / gamma_1 >= ramp threshold (the shaft absorbed), otherwise fail_above_floor

span_pins.rule: a pool spanning less than the threshold in max/min carrier cannot identify the speed laws, so they are constants at their prior medians (no site, no prior term)

measured.profile_centre: measured floor at k f_r - below - odd penalty (round 4)

not_v3_sites.note: lam is pinned in v3 flight; v2 mic gains are data-normalised
